items.title: 13.4 Gas ki ausat translational kinetic energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of average translational kinetic energy (PDF 9-11).

blocks.text: Ab hum gas qanoon PV = nRT ko kinetic theory ke nateeje PV = (1/3) N m <v^2> se milate hain. Dono barabar karne se: nRT = (1/3) N m <v^2> = (1/3) N m v_rms^2 (13.15), is liye m v_rms^2 = 3nRT/N. Kyunke N/n = NA aik mole mein molecules ki tadaad hai, m v_rms^2 = 3RT/NA, jis se v_rms = (3RT/(m NA)) ka square root (13.16) milta hai. kB = R/NA istemal karne se yeh (1/2) m <v^2> = (3/2) kB T (13.17) ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Ausat translational kinetic energy
blocks.text: Gas molecule ki ausat translational kinetic energy <K.E.> = (1/2) m v_rms^2 = (3/2) kB T (13.18) hai. Yeh sirf mutlaq darja hararat par munhasir hai. Dabao ko P = (2/3) No <K.E.> bhi likh sakte hain, jahan No fi ikai hajm molecules ki tadaad hai.

Yun molecules ki ausat translational kinetic energy sirf aik constant guna darja hararat hai: agar yeh model durust hai to gas ka darja hararat us ke molecules ki ausat translational kinetic energy ka seedha paimana hai. Kamre ke darja hararat (300 K) par hawa ke molecule ke liye kB T = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1 x 300 K = 4.14 x 10^-21 J. Itni chhoti tawanaiyon ke liye electron volt use hota hai: 1 eV woh kinetic energy hai jo electron aik volt ke potential farq se tez kiye jane par hasil karta hai, 1 eV = 1.6 x 10^-19 J. kB = 8.62 x 10^-5 eV K^-1 se 300 K par kB T = 0.026 eV.
Rozmarra zindagi mein kinetic theory ki misalein

items: Popcorn: jab makai ka dana garam hota hai to andar qaid nami bhaap ban jati hai. Daane ke andar dabao itna barhta hai ke chhilka phat kar starch bahar aa jata hai, jo thanda ho kar thos ho jata hai (kitab ki Fig 13.3 popcorn ki tasveer hai).

Gari ke tyre: tyre mein hawa bharne se mehdood hajm mein hawa ke molecules ki tadaad barhti hai, is liye tyre ki deewaron se takkarein zyada aur dabao barh jata hai. Yeh dabao tyre ko sakht rakhta aur gari ka wazan uthata hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Kinetic theory samajhne mein madad deti hai ke aaloodgi fiza se kaise amal karti hai. Yeh ilm hawa ke mayaar ki nigrani ke nizam banane mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar gas ka mutlaq darja hararat dugna kar diya jaye to rms raftar kitne guna badalti hai?
blocks.explanation: v_rms T ke square root ke mutanasib hai, is liye yeh 2 ke square root, taqreeban 1.41, guna barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya aik hi kamre mein oxygen aur nitrogen ke molecules ki ausat kinetic energy barabar hai? Kya rms raftar barabar hai?
blocks.explanation: Ausat kinetic energy barabar, (3/2) kB T, kyunke yeh sirf darja hararat par munhasir hai. Rms raftarein mukhtalif: halke N2 molecules tez chalte hain (25 C par 515 ke muqable 481 m s^-1).

items: v_rms = (3RT/M) ka square root = (3 kB T/m) ka square root.
<K.E.> = (1/2) m v_rms^2 = (3/2) kB T: darja hararat ausat KE ka paimana.
